Train collision with school van in Bengal kills three

A collision between a train and a school van at a railway crossing in Bengal has resulted in the deaths of three individuals, including two students. Authorities have arrested the railway gateman, who is reportedly intoxicated, in connection with the incident. The accident occurred at an open level-crossing.
